Capture what matters and move your intentions forward

Savor is an Intention Layer for all those thoughts that never quite make it onto your to-do list. You can speak, type, or snap a photo, and Savor creates a clear card organized into Now, Soon, or Later. Reminders bring each thought back when it actually matters. The Take Action (Beta) feature helps you explore your options, build a plan or list, and draft words you can use. You can review and adjust as you go, or hand off a whole card or a single step with a private chat for context. You decide what happens next, and it is free on iOS and Android.

Okay, big day for us! SAVOR is live on Product Hunt! For me, this started with being tired of trying to remember everything and still feeling like I was forgetting something. Work stuff, things for the kids, ideas I wanted to explore. Things that mattered to me, but often occurred to me while I was in the middle of something else. I wanted somewhere I could put those things down, trust that I wouldn’t lose them, and get back to the life in front of me. That’s what we’ve been building with SAVOR. You can speak, type, or take a photo, and SAVOR helps turn it into a clear Card you can return to, refine, and act on when you’re ready. Somewhere to hold onto what you mean to do, even before you’ve figured out exactly what that looks like. I’d love for you to check out our Product Hunt page and [...] # Kate Ramakaieva’s Post
